headline: Plevris: Golden Visas Will Be Revoked for Fictitious Discounts and Violations of the Short-Term Rental Ban
summary: Greek Migration Minister Thanos Plevris warned that Golden Visas will be revoked for agreements that indirectly reduce the actual purchase price or for violating the short-term rental ban.
why: The Golden Visa scheme grants residency in exchange for real estate investment, making it a significant driver of Greek property demand.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
